title: Engineering Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
!

Engineering Talent Acquisition Specialist
South West England - 1 day per week at Gloucester or Cwmbran
Hybrid
Looking after the people who make Safran great is our priority. We offer a range of flexible benefits designed to support you-both in and out of work, including:
Competitive salary
Company performance bonus scheme
Pension scheme - up to 10% employer contribution
Private medical insurance
25 days annual leave + bank holidays
We support your ambitions with training, development, a personalised career plan and mobility opportunities.
Safran - Here, we craft excellence together.
At Safran, excellence is a journey - and we'd love you to be a part of it. As a trusted global leader in aerospace, defence, and space, we are proud to be a company where diversity, innovation, and opportunity come together to shape a sustainable future where we can all succeed together through a shared vision.
Your Role
Our Talent Acquisition Specialists are responsible for delivering strategic, high-quality hiring solutions that build exceptional teams and strengthen Safran's position as an employer of choice.
Focused on our Engineering job families, as a Talent Acquisition Specialist you will support all Safran businesses in the UK across roles in R&D, R&T and Engineering.
By partnering with business leaders, optimizing recruitment processes, and championing candidate experience, these roles ensure Safran attracts, engages, and retains top talent to fuel innovation and growth across all UK sites.
This is a hybrid role and the successful candidate will have a fixed base at one of our South West site, either Gloucester or Cwmbran with an on-site requirement of at least one day per week.
Responsibilities:
Oversee the end-to-end recruitment process for approximately 50 hires per year, ensuring smooth coordination, timely communication, and a positive experience for both candidates and hiring managers
Manage the full recruitment process from vacancy approval through to offer and onboarding.
Partner with hiring managers to understand hiring needs and agree recruitment plans.
Build strong talent pipelines through targeted sourcing, networking, and employer branding initiatives
Act as a subject matter expert for recruitment within your perimeter, providing insights on market trends, sourcing strategies, and candidate experience enhancements
Ensure quality and accuracy of data in our ATS for requisitions, reporting, and candidate communications
Apply Safran's equal opportunity principles and maintain compliance with all relevant standards

What You'll Bring
Proven experience managing end-to-end recruitment within an agency or in-house setting with a focus on Technical, Engineering and Research and Development roles
Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build trust and influence hiring decisions at all levels.
Efficient, with great organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple vacancies, projects, and priorities effectively.
Excellent communication skills, with a proactive, transparent and solutions-focused approach to problem solving.
Ability to use recruitment data and market insights to improve hiring outcomes and optimise processes.
Get involved:
We have a number of groups and forums across our sites that you can get involved with, including Women at Safran, Diversity at Safran, Sports Clubs, STEM ambassadors, Employee Forum, Charity Partnerships and Wellbeing Programs.
If you're ready to take your career to new heights and be part of a company that's crafting the future of flight, apply today.

title: HR Administrator
company: G-TEKT Europe Manufacturing Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
The HR Administrator will play a key part in ensuring a smooth and professional HR function, supporting both day-to-day operational requirements and longer-term people initiatives.

This role will support our two plants onsite in our head office in Brockworth Gloucester. This role would suit someone who is comfortable working in a fast-paced HR department, with strong organisational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities.

Role Responsibilities
- Providing administration support across the full employee life cycle. Completing administration for new starters, leavers, inductions and off boarding.
- Respond to daily queries from employees and managers in person and through HR email inbox
- Recruitment and screening for production roles including ensuring compliance with right to work checks
- Absence monitoring includes management of everyday sickness absence notifications and relevant documentation.
- Provide timely information to payroll, maintaining data accuracy and compliance across systems and shared inbox
- Identifying and implementing system and process improvements and contribute to weekly meetings.
- Supporting Assistant Manager with compliance and ad hoc HR projects including community engagement activities
- Arranging occupational health for new starters
- Updating and maintaining HR system

Qualifications and experience
- Experience as an administrator working within the manufacturing industry (desirable)
- Level 3 CIPD (desirable)
- Basic awareness of employment law
- Must have strong communication, interpersonal skills and time management
- A high level of accuracy and attention to detail.
- Possess a high level of integrity and confidentiality
- Resilient under pressure
- Hours 37.5 hours per week (Onsite) Mon-Fri
- Paid overtime as agreed by manager
- 25 days holiday
- Potential for Advancement
